findings.shape: A selected broad red tongue-like bracket is laterally attached to an explicitly contextual woody support. Its rounded outline, closed margin and separate lower tubules replace the old undifferentiated disc and pebble-like support.
findings.surface: Darker red numerical pigment, muted wet sheen, fine upper papillae and pale open-ended tubule relief. No reference-photo pixels or calibrated reflectance.
findings.movement: The same stationary fruit body is retained while an optional greatly enlarged authored spore-drift overlay starts at selected tube surfaces. Growth, decomposition, discharge mechanics and airflow are unavailable.
findings.evidenceScope: The actual Czech Jiří Berkovec photograph was compared with selected Naturalis and Funga Nordica descriptions and primary regional-taxonomic context. The photograph does not expose the tubes; their separate construction is separately supported by the taxonomic text. No paper figures or measured coordinates were imported.
corrections: Darkened and flattened the excessively pale, domed first render.
Rounded angular fan ends; shortened and regularized separate tubules after underside inspection.
Improved lower-surface visibility without claiming calibrated tissue optics.
findings.residual: The bracket outline and attachment still look authored, tubule positions are idealized and bark support is contextual artwork. Fine tissue structure, guttation, age variation, real optical response, hyphal physiology and dimensions remain unmeasured or absent.

limits: Partly stylized, unmeasured original educational reconstructions. Fine anatomy, age variation, tissue optics, dimensions and physiology remain incomplete. No independent specialist validation, scientific certification or accuracy percentage.
